discription: A lush, evolving pad sound crafted from detuned saw waves, shaped by a slow ADSR envelope, and filtered through a resonant low-pass filter for warmth and movement.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=8000, rq=0.5, detuneAmount=0.003; var sig, env; var numOscs = 3; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attackTime: 1.0, decayTime: 2.0, sustainLevel: 0.6, releaseTime: 4.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Mix.new(Array.fill(numOscs, { |i| var detunedFreq = freq * (1 + (i - (numOscs - 1) / 2) * detuneAmount); Saw.ar(detunedFreq) })) * (1/numOscs); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
